mapper.insert: INSERT INTO survey_record_detail (record_id, resident_status, scores, supports, source, transcript) VALUES (#{recordId}, #{residentStatus}, #{scores}, #{supports}, #{source}, #{transcript})
INSERT INTO survey_photo (record_id, file_name, label) VALUES (#{recordId}, #{fileName}, #{label})
mapper.select: SELECT photo_id, record_id, file_name, label, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') created_at FROM survey_photo WHERE record_id IN #{id} ORDER BY photo_id

SELECT p.photo_id, p.record_id, p.file_name, p.label, v.bld_id FROM survey_photo p JOIN survey_record r ON r.record_id = p.record_id JOIN visit_history v ON v.visit_id = r.visit_id WHERE p.photo_id = #{photoId}
SELECT v.bld_id FROM survey_record r JOIN visit_history v ON v.visit_id = r.visit_id WHERE r.record_id = #{recordId} AND v.user_id = #{userId}
